subject.title: fix(agents): handle stdin stream errors in docker sandbox execution

question: Should this PR be narrowed to only the Docker stdin stream-error fix before merge, or should maintainers intentionally adopt the unrelated Gateway, Browser, Codex, crypto, Android/i18n, docs, and changelog changes in this branch?
rationale: The Docker fix is narrow, but the current branch is conflicting and carries compatibility/security-sensitive behavior outside the PR's stated problem; automation cannot infer maintainer intent for those extra surfaces.

options.title: Narrow to Docker stdin only
options.body: Rebase or replace the branch so it contains only `src/agents/sandbox/docker.ts`, the focused Docker test update, and matching proof for the stdin stream-error path.

options.title: Sponsor the expanded branch
options.body: A maintainer can retitle/re-scope the PR, resolve conflicts, and require separate proof for the Gateway, Browser, Codex, crypto, Android/i18n, docs, and changelog changes before merge.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: If the branch drift is not worth untangling, close this PR after opening or requesting a fresh narrow replacement for the useful Docker fix.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Docker stdin only
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the branch so it contains only `src/agents/sandbox/docker.ts`, the focused Docker test update, and matching proof for the stdin stream-error path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the latest branch changes that mixed the additional surfaces into the PR.
